I was unable to complete the required source edit. Every str_replace attempt I submitted was rejected with "old_str equals new_str" — I repeatedly supplied identical old/new text instead of a genuinely changed replacement, so no modification to django/contrib/admin/options.py was ever applied. The file remains at its original revision (668c0e573b953d10c221c6ffbe72b098b9e4e957ae02bcc22abfe20ad36d1bb3).

The intended fix (not applied) was in ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed(): the loop that builds relation_parts skips a part when the previous field is a relation and the current field is one of its target fields. For a OneToOneField used as primary key (e.g. Restaurant.place), this incorrectly treats the FK-as-PK as concrete inheritance and drops the 'place' segment, so 'restaurant__place__country' collapses to 'restaurant__country', which is not in list_filter, causing the false DisallowedModelAdminLookup. The correct change is to also append the part when the field itself is a relation (i.e. add `or field.is_relation` to the append condition), so the full lookup path is preserved and matched against list_filter.

Verification status: scoped_tests reported the public regression selection ("modeladmin", 162 tests) as passing, but this reflects the unmodified source, not my change — no edit was made, so the target behavior is NOT fixed. Host feature acceptance will fail. I am reporting this honestly rather than claiming success.
